messages:
Leah (People Ops): Hi folks—I'm pulling together a compact manager onboarding packet. Focus: practical first-week agenda, a lightweight 30/60/90 template, and a who-to-ask cheat sheet. Quick draft below, please add gaps or owners.

Leah (People Ops): COMPACT DRAFT:
• Day -1 (pre-start): laptop shipped, SSO invite accepted, VPN + kerberos tested (owner: IT)
• Day 0: welcome email + benefits walkthrough (HR), sign data access addendum (Ava)
• Day 1 AM: team kickoff (30m) + 1:1 with direct reports (15m each, scheduled)
• Day 1 PM: infra overview (45m) — end-to-end inference path + runtime roles (eng-runtime)
• Week 1: shadow standups, review open tickets, attend product sync, set 30-day priorities
• Week 2: finalize 30/60/90, compliance trainings complete (Security 101, Data Handling)
• 30/60/90: concise measurable outcomes (see template below)
• Who-to-ask quick list: IT (access), Eng-Infra (deploys), Eng-Security (keys), Finance (cost center), People-Ops (HR/policies), Legal (contracts)

Priya (Recruiting): Nice. Add a line: managers should hold weekly 1:1s with reports and schedule a skip-level within first 30 days. Also include a bullet about collecting interview feedback templates for hiring.

Samir (Eng Manager): Add a 60m runtime deep-dive (KV cache, batching, quantization impact) with eng-runtime. Also include the oncall escalation snippet and links to `#eng-oncall` and the PagerDuty runbook.

Jordan (Product): For 30/60/90 sample goals:
• 30d: meet cross-functional partners, deliver onboarding doc for the team, baseline metric (99th pct latency, token cost)
• 60d: lead a small rollout/experiment, iterate on batching or model variant settings to save X% token cost
• 90d: own rollout plan + rollback criteria and SLA targets (uptime/latency)

Ava (HR): Reminder: private deployment keys gated on signed data addendum. I'll attach compliance deadlines and add course links to the packet.

Maddie (Onboarding Buddy): I'll volunteer as buddy for first two weeks. I can run shadow sessions and help schedule cross-team intros. Prefer AM blocks for deep dives. :wave:

onboard-bot: Buddy assigned: Maddie. Calendar invites sent for "Runtime Intro" and "Team Standup".

Leah (People Ops): Good additions. I'll: add the runtime walkthrough, pager links, compliance due dates, and Priya's 1:1 guidance. Also will include a tiny meeting checklist to avoid calendar chaos (HR intro, Security, Eng-runtime, Product, Buddy, Finance).

Samir (Eng Manager): Quick troubleshooting snippet for infra tickets to paste: ```
Subject: New manager infra access - <name>
Steps tried: VPN, laptop restart, kube-auth refresh
Attached: screenshot, error logs
Priority: P2
```

Priya (Recruiting): And add a short note for hiring managers: "submit role/req notes to Recruiting within 14 days" so we capture candidate pipeline.

Leah (People Ops): Great—I'll fold these in and tag owners. Plan: quick review with Maddie + Priya then publish. Target: EOD Friday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jordan (Product): Looks good — short and actionable.

Ava (HR): I'll drop the compliance doc links once the packet is live.

Maddie (Onboarding Buddy): Happy to review before publish.
